label: STRN::ALK

sections.text: STRN encodes striatin, a scaffold in signaling complexes including STRIPAK.
ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development.

The fusion retains the ALK kinase domain under an amino-terminal partner that promotes abnormal kinase activation. It is a rare driver in lung adenocarcinoma. Clinical responses to ALK inhibition have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma.
ALK-directed treatment is supported by the ALK-positive NSCLC indication; the cited evidence for this particular partner is a case report.
